name: Evaluate and classify specific physical and anthropometric measurements
description: Users asked to evaluate, classify, or calculate specific physical, anthropometric, or physiological metrics, such as body dimensions, fitness performance, organ function, and statistical distributions. Requests ranged from interpreting clinical measurements and standard size notations to estimating physical limits and comparing abstract measurements against human bodies.
